title: Smart Data Models - ERA ERADIS - MaxDurationConstraint
description: Maximum duration constraint (era:MaxDurationConstraint's own definition, verbatim, in the source ontology): A validity constraint that imposes an upper bound on the CLD validity period. Being a subclass of time:DurationDescription, it uses time:years (and potentially time:months, time:days) to express the maximum allowed duration.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MaxDurationConstraint'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

months.description: Property. Number of months of the maximum duration (time:months, from the W3C OWL-Time DurationDescription era:MaxDurationConstraint subclasses; not independently fetched in this pass).

years.description: Property. Number of years of the maximum duration (time:years, from the W3C OWL-Time DurationDescription era:MaxDurationConstraint subclasses; not independently fetched in this pass).
